statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
A mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring study (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is ordered to evaluate for a potential arrhythmic etiology of these symptoms
The claim was denied under reason code CO-50
The denial was based on the service not meeting coverage criteria for medical necessity
